about.lead: I thrive in autonomous, product-focused teams where engineering velocity matches long-term architecture health.
bio: My approach couples robust backend performance with responsive, accessible user experiences. On the backend I design Go microservices with gRPC, Redis caching and tuned Postgres; on the frontend I ship clean Next.js App Router interfaces with a sharp eye for state, structure and reuse.
Beyond client work I build in the open — I'm the creator of shadcn-chat, a React component library that streamlines chat-interface development inside the shadcn/ui ecosystem.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer · Next.js + Go
bullets: Owned a full **Contact Tags system across 6 microservice repos** — Go gRPC service, REST gateway and the entire React filtering UI.
Migrated in-memory caches to **Redis across 3 Go services**, eliminating state drift between concurrent instances.

roles.title: Middle Frontend Developer
bullets: Built the **Call Flow Editor** — a node-based UI for phone-automation workflows with step validation and complex state.
Shipped **i18n across 5 languages** and mentored a junior developer through code reviews.

roles.title: Junior Frontend Developer
bullets: Built Next.js App Router pages with mixed **SSR / CSR** rendering and Server/Client components.
Delivered a multi-step TCR/CSP compliance form with branching fields and Zod validation.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Maintained a legacy Next.js/React app, optimizing dashboards and graphs and wiring a from-scratch UI to the existing GraphQL API.
Built a **Telegram bot for infrastructure failure alerts**.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Designed and shipped a **microservice-based restaurant menu designer** — full CRUD/REST on MongoDB, auth, and a Next.js + shadcn/ui storefront from Figma.
Built a critical **Poster POS integration** routing digital-menu orders straight to the venue's terminal, and Dockerized services for deploy.

projects.title: CV Builder

projects.title: Digital Menu Designer
projects.description: A microservice-based restaurant menu builder with full CRUD on MongoDB, a Next.js + shadcn/ui storefront, and a live Poster POS order integration.
